hyperedges.label: Core ChangeNotifier services exposed via AppServices

nodes.label: Design System (tokens + primitives)
nodes.rationale: Tokens in lib/ui/theme.dart, primitives in lib/ui/primitives; no raw hex, no ad-hoc font sizes, no restyled primitive copies.

nodes.label: Apple-teardown Motion Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Slow overshoot entrances (~500ms), fast ease-in exits (150ms), translate stagger 0.7s vs opacity 0.9s, opacity/transform only, respect disableAnimations.

nodes.label: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key, Gemini first)
nodes.norm_label: byok (bring your own key, gemini first)

nodes.label: Canvas LMS Integration
nodes.rationale: Course material pulled straight from Canvas so students need no manual uploads.

nodes.label: Stack: Flutter 3.47 web, Material 3, no state-mgmt packages
nodes.norm_label: stack: flutter 3.47 web, material 3, no state-mgmt packages
nodes.rationale: Only extra dependency is 'web' for the iframe; colours use withValues(alpha:) never withOpacity.

nodes.label: Zakerly Build Contract
nodes.rationale: Every agent reads this first; core layer lib/core is finished and owned by the lead - read, don't edit; report gaps instead.

nodes.label: One-Screen Layout Rule (no page scroll)
nodes.rationale: On desktop (>=1100x680) everything fits with no page scroll; only chat list scrolls; other lists capped with '+N more'; use Expanded/Flexible, never page-level ListView/SingleChildScrollView.

nodes.label: Model Request Pacing (live-first, off-peak indexing)
nodes.rationale: Live questions take priority; heavy indexing waits for an off-peak window, capped at N requests/min.

nodes.label: Teaching-first UI
nodes.rationale: Student stays in the driver's seat and always sees remaining budget.

nodes.label: Verification Gate (flutter analyze + build web)
nodes.rationale: No test suite; clean analyze plus successful web build is the gate.
